text:
Priya S: quick sync - proposal to introduce a compact lifecycle fieldset for pins: `lifecycle_intent`, `soft_expiry_sec`, `hard_expiry_ts`, `rollback_ref`. aim: single canonical behaviour across hosted/dedicated/private.

Tom B: sounds good. want exact enum values and expected runtime transitions please.

Priya S: draft enums: `lifecycle_intent` = \"permanent|rolling|ephemeral\". semantics: permanent -> no auto-evict; rolling -> short trial with automatic rollback suggestion; ephemeral -> auto-evict after soft expiry. `soft_expiry_sec` optional; `hard_expiry_ts` optional but used for guaranteed eviction. `rollback_ref` opaque string.

Lucas W: conflict cases? multiple controllers could race (deploy, autoscaler, manual). propose deterministic rule: explicit-override (RBAC) > intent-rank (permanent>rolling>ephemeral) > last-write. log conflict resolution details to audit.

Tom B: runtime note: when soft_expiry hits, mark pin as `stale` in metadata and continue serving until hard_expiry, unless overridden. trace span should include pin metadata for any request served by a stale pin.

security-bot: reminder: `rollback_ref` must not include secrets. store as opaque identifier only. audit actor and auth method on changes.

Priya S: small API example:
PATCH /v1/models/{model}/pins/{pin_id}
{
  "lifecycle_intent": "rolling",
  "soft_expiry_sec": 7200,
  "hard_expiry_ts": "2026-04-01T12:00:00Z",
  "rollback_ref": "variant:search-v2-20260401",
  "pin_note": "try 10% canary for search-rank"
}

Lucas W: indexes: add composite `(tenant_id, model_id, effective_hard_expiry)` and TTL index for soft expiries to help eviction sweeps. also keep an in-memory min-heap of top-1000 soonest expiries per region to avoid full table scans.

Tom B: telemetry: counters `pin.create`, `pin.update`, `pin.mark_stale`, `pin.evict`, `pin.override`. labels: intent, owner, outcome. alerts for sudden spike in `pin.evict` or `pin.override`.

Priya S: migration plan: add nullable fields, deploy control-plane to accept but ignore for older clients, backfill in background, enable conflict resolution policy behind flag for 2 weeks, then flip. owners: Priya schema+migration, Tom runtime+indexes, Lucas telemetry+alerts.

deploy-bot: created task PIN-2026 with checklist (schema, migration, indexes, telemetry, RBAC).

Tom B: one more: add `pin_note` length cap 512 and persist as non-indexed. ensures debugging but avoids index bloat.

Priya S: agreed. also add `conflict_count` metric and surface in pin detail page.

Lucas W: SGTM, will add dashboard panels.

Priya S: thanks all, I'll open the schema PR and link the ticket. :rocket:
